headline: Romanians Know Inflation Is Eating Their Savings, but Still Don't Invest. Seven in Ten Keep Money Under the Mattress or in Accounts
summary: Only 29% of surveyed Romanians say they invest in shares, bonds, funds or ETFs, compared with a European average of 41%. Seven in ten keep money under the mattress or in accounts.
why: Household savings and investment participation shape domestic capital markets and savings flows. Low participation limits the depth of local equity and bond markets.
